title: VALUES returning several rows where a scalar is expected is an error

expected.error: VALUES ( Product[Color] ) has three rows and cannot be converted to a single value

source.quote: DAX tries to convert the table to a scalar value, and it fails if there are multiple rows.
source.supports: a table of several rows does not convert to a scalar

source.quote: In this case, the VALUES function returns a table of multiple rows. Comparing a table of multiple rows to a scalar value results in an error.
source.supports: VALUES with several rows used as a scalar is an error

derivation: With no filter Product[Color] has Red, Blue and Green. ROW needs a scalar for its column, and a three-row table cannot be converted to one.
